hints.tr: `while heap:` içinde `d, city = heapq.heappop(heap)`; `city == goal` ise `return d`; `d > dist[city]` ise `continue`.
hints.en: Inside `while heap:`, `d, city = heapq.heappop(heap)`; if `city == goal`, `return d`; if `d > dist[city]`, `continue`.

hints.tr: Her komşuda `d + cost` daha küçükse `dist`'i güncelle ve heap'e it.
hints.en: For each neighbour, if `d + cost` is smaller, update `dist` and push to the heap.
